en: The image is a black-and-white illustration, likely a print or drawing, depicting a religious, possibly mystical scene. At the center bottom is a bearded male figure in a robe, writing with a quill on a scroll or palette held by cherubic children. To the right, there is a feminine figure holding a decorative frame, and above, multiple ethereal, angelic faces surround the scene. In the middle background, a glowing childlike figure stands, possibly representing a holy child or Christ figure. The style has a 19th or early 20th-century European flavor, with mystical and Christian iconography.
